harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Pinned curl to its currently installed version (8.17.0-r1) on node1 by constraining it in /etc/apk/world (curl=8.17.0-r1), which apk respects as a version hold. Verified a real apk upgrade (133 packages, including an available curl 8.22.0-r0) left curl/libcurl untouched at 8.17.0-r1 while everything else updated. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, natively rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified curl stayed pinned, functional, and the world-file pin persisted after reboot and after a fresh apk index sync.
actions_performed: Inspected OS (Alpine 3.23.3) and installed curl version (8.17.0-r1) via apk info -e / apk list --installed
Ran apk update to sync APKINDEX, confirmed curl 8.22.0-r0 was available upstream (a real upgrade candidate existed)
Backed up /etc/apk/world and edited it to pin curl to the exact installed version: curl=8.17.0-r1
Verified via apk upgrade --simulate that curl/libcurl no longer appear in the upgrade plan
Ran a real apk upgrade (133 packages) and confirmed curl was skipped while other packages (util-linux, pcre2, etc.) upgraded normally
Post-upgrade verified curl-8.17.0-r1/libcurl-8.17.0-r1 still installed and curl --version/functionality intact
Captured baseline boot_id (f27bb0ed-2dfc-42fb-a0ca-47296914ff4f) and uptime -s before restart
Triggered a native reboot via a backgrounded 'reboot' command so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming a new boot_id (7ba884c4-44fe-42cb-8a6f-4324e06dced7) and new boot time, proving an actual restart occurred

Post-restart verified curl-8.17.0-r1 still installed, the pin still present in /etc/apk/world, curl works (successful HTTPS GET), and a fresh apk update + upgrade --simulate still excludes curl from upgrades

evidence.requirement: Identify current curl version and confirm an upgrade candidate exists (making the hold meaningful)
evidence.summary: curl-8.17.0-r1 was installed; apk update showed curl 8.22.0-r0 upstream and apk upgrade --simulate listed curl as upgradable before the pin was applied.

evidence.requirement: Pin curl in /etc/apk/world to its current version
evidence.summary: Backed up /etc/apk/world and rewrote the 'curl' entry to 'curl=8.17.0-r1'.

evidence.requirement: Prove the hold prevents curl from being upgraded
evidence.summary: apk upgrade --simulate no longer listed curl/libcurl; a real apk upgrade of 133 packages left curl at 8.17.0-r1 (confirmed via apk info/apk list and curl --version) while other packages upgraded.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f27bb0ed-2dfc-42fb-a0ca-47296914ff4f and boot time 2026-09-29 09:52:59 as baseline, with curl already pinned and healthy.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded native 'reboot' on node1 so the exec call returned successfully before the node disconnected; only node1 was targeted.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proves an actual restart
evidence.summary: After polling through connection resets/timeouts, node1 came back with boot_id 7ba884c4-44fe-42cb-8a6f-4324e06dced7 and new boot time 2026-09-29 09:54:34, differing from baseline.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of curl hold and functionality
evidence.summary: After reboot, curl-8.17.0-r1/libcurl-8.17.0-r1 remained installed, the world-file pin persisted, curl successfully performed an HTTPS request, and a fresh apk update + upgrade --simulate still excluded curl from any upgrade.

attempts.summary: Pinned curl to its currently installed version (8.17.0-r1) on node1 by constraining it in /etc/apk/world (curl=8.17.0-r1), which apk respects as a version hold. Verified a real apk upgrade (133 packages, including an available curl 8.22.0-r0) left curl/libcurl untouched at 8.17.0-r1 while everything else updated. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, natively rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified curl stayed pinned, functional, and the world-file pin persisted after reboot and after a fresh apk index sync.
